summary: Fixed the 134 test_smoke_units shard cases: numbers._get_number_symbols now falls back to the latn symbol table when a numbering system is stored only as an alias (the importer writes the bare alias tag as the string 'None'), which clears the KeyError 'decimal' failures, and units.format_unit tolerates locales that lack the requested length (another fixer's edit, re-verified). Last full-suite run: 6685 passed, 19 failed, 5 skipped; all 134 shard tests pass, and the 19 remaining failures are in tests/messages and the zoneinfo date tests, outside this shard.
